assumptions.status: Rev03 adopted course design inputs; assumptions are not measured site data
assumptions.origin: Customer main incomer outgoing terminals; utility transformer tails excluded from customer voltage-drop allowance

riser.length_basis: Proposed maximum developed MSB-to-F1 tap route allowance, including horizontal distribution and vertical rise; not a measured building height. Meter tails are included in the existing tenant feeder 3 m allowance.
riser.sources: DEBU024EN Canalis KT: printed143/PDF145 impedance and fault ratings; printed145/PDF147 harmonic ratings; temperature factor table. Balancing, route and connection allowances are declared design assumptions.

earthing.system: TN-S design assumption; utility agreement required; customer MET and own electrode; no downstream PEN or N-PE bridge
earthing.basis: Design acceptance limit, not a site result; any optional CLP earth bond must not be the sole earth path. Verify with that bond disconnected under CLP Supply Rules 304.
earthing.main_trip: MicroLogic 6.0X IEC LSIG with four-pole phase/neutral sensors
earthing.source: DOCA0102EN-12 ground-fault settings pp118-119; CLP GuideToSupply v10 section2

cold_fault_bound.basis: Indoor conductor temperature >=0C; effective copper area <=110% nominal and conductivity <=102% IACS. NBS Handbook100 gives rho20=1/58 ohm mm2/m and alpha20=0.00393/C. Resulting rho0/(1.10*1.02)=0.014159 > adopted0.014. Upstream resistance and all reactance omitted for maximum-fault bound.
cold_fault_bound.RCBO_backup: NSX100H upstream: iC60H RCBO (VD) 6-20A reinforced40kA; 32-45A reinforced25kA at380-415V/220-240V phase-neutral. LVPED318033EN printedA-198/PDF206. Cascading is not full selectivity.

incoming_MCCB.source: C10H4TM063 manufacturer data sheet; DOCA0187EN-04 p235 TM63D trip curve; LVPED221001EN H-44/PDF396 energy-limitation envelope for NSX100 TM40-100 at415V

voltage_drop.basis: Classroom1.5/2.5 allocation checked at diversified design demand. Also retain a separate full63A feeder stress check against4% total. Fundamental-frequency calculation; not a harmonic voltage-distortion study.

coupler.interlock: Electrical and mechanical ACB-A/ACB-B/BC; never all three closed; isolate failed source and shed load before closing tie

main_OC_settings.basis: MicroLogicX p110; CLP GuideToSupply Appendix1 2500A dashed curve; no full selectivity claimed

system_results.checks_scope: Calculated under declared design assumptions. No site/utility acceptance or full selectivity claimed. I2t apparatus performance remains an explicit procurement/coordination condition for all fault types.
